subject: general
question: If sin θ cos θ = (sqrt2)/(3), then the value of (sin⁶ θ + cos⁶ θ) is:
solution:
Formula used:

(sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = 1 - 3 sin²θcos²θ 

Calculation:

sin θ cos θ = (sqrt2)/(3)

Squaring both sides and multiplying both sides by 3,

⇒ 3 × sin² θ cos² θ = 3 × ( (sqrt2)/(3) )² = 3 × (2)/(9) = (2)/(3)

According to the formula,

⇒ (sin6 θ + cos6 θ) = 1 - 3 sin2θcos2θ

⇒ 1- (2)/(3) = (1)/(3)

∴ The required value is 1/3.
